papers.title: Systematic Review and External Validation of Clinical Prediction Models for Adverse Pregnancy Outcomes Using Routinely Collected Pre-Conception and Early Pregnancy Data
papers.summary:
-  We classified 70 files: 65 data, 4 documentation, 1 materials.
-  We found 65 tabular data files and extracted 309 columns from 40 of them.
-  We grouped the files into 2 study groups (ex1, ex2), plus 1 collection-level file (README/ro-crate metadata).
-  25 files read as a table but are not a usable rectangular dataset (fetal_growth_restriction_icd10.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; gestational_diabetes_icd10.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; gestational_hypertension_icd10.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; macrosomia_icd10.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; pre_eclampsia_icd10.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; stillbirth_icd10.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; antiphospholipid_syndrome_icd10.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; assisted_conception_icd10.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; chronic_hypertension_icd10.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; diabetes_1_icd10.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; diabetes_2_icd10.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; diabetes_icd10.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; family_history_of_diabetes_2_icd10.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; family_history_of_diabetes_icd10.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; family_history_of_hypertension_icd10.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; hellp_syndrome_icd10.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; in_vitro_fertilisation_icd10.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; infertility_icd10.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; ovulation_induction_icd10.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; renal_disease_icd10.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; smoke_icd10.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; systemic_lupus_erythematosus_icd10.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; thrombophilia_icd10.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; thyroid_disease_icd10.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; venous_thromboembolism_icd10.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables). papers.summary:
-  We classified 18 files: 4 data, 1 documentation, 13 unknown.
-  We found 4 tabular data files and extracted 62 columns from 3 of them.
-  We grouped the files into 1 study group (pilot1).
-  1 tabular data file could not be read because it was not downloaded. This can happen for private repositories or failed downloads; you can also pass `local_path` to point at a local copy. We ran automated data-quality checks on 62 columns; 36 columns have at least one potential issue (24 columns with numeric values stored as text; 12 columns with no observed values (entirely empty); 4 columns whose name contains file-illegal characters or is excessively long). 3 of 3 spreadsheet files have at least one formatting issue (colour coding, merged cells, empty rows/columns, or an offset header).

papers.title: Heterogeneity in excess respiratory acute care utilization during wildfire smoke waves in California
papers.summary:
-  We classified 290 files: 10 data, 239 code, 9 documentation, 27 materials, 5 unknown.
-  We found 5 tabular data files and extracted 19 columns from 4 of them.
-  We grouped the files into 2 study groups (ex1, ex2), plus 5 collection-level files (README/ro-crate metadata).
-  1 R workspace file (`.RData`/`.rda`) contains no reusable tabular data — only fitted models or saved session objects. Such files need R (and the exact packages used) to open and are not machine-readable. Share the underlying data as CSV (or a documented `.sav`/`.dta`) with a codebook so it can be reused without R: m750_splits.rda. We ran automated data-quality checks on 19 columns; 1 column has at least one potential issue (1 column with no observed values (entirely empty)).

-  We found 7 tabular data files and extracted 151 columns from 6 of them.

No columns were extracted and they were not sent to the LLM. Share the underlying data as a plain rectangular table (one header row, one column per variable) with a codebook: Frequency_OSF_deposit_7Oct.zip/data/reanalysis_output.txt. We detected demographic column for Age. 4 of 4 spreadsheet files have at least one formatting issue (colour coding, merged cells, empty rows/columns, or an offset header).

papers.title: The same practices, year after year: a national observational study of higher-risk antibiotic prescribing in English general practice, 2023-2026
papers.summary:
-  We classified 82 files: 51 data, 13 code, 4 documentation, 13 materials, 1 unknown.
-  We found 49 tabular data files and extracted 895 columns from 47 of them.
-  We grouped the files into 1 study group (ex1), plus 1 collection-level file (README/ro-crate metadata).
-  1 file read as a table but is not a usable rectangular dataset (atypical_practices.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables). No columns were extracted and they were not sent to the LLM. Share the underlying data as a plain rectangular table (one header row, one column per variable) with a codebook: atypical_practices.csv. We ran automated data-quality checks on 895 columns; 202 columns have at least one potential issue (146 columns with numeric values stored as text; 29 columns whose name contains file-illegal characters or is excessively long; 16 columns whose name suggests personal information; 12 columns with no observed values (entirely empty); 1 column with values in a legacy (non-UTF-8) encoding). We detected demographic columns for Age, Gender. 1 of 2 spreadsheet files has at least one formatting issue (colour coding, merged cells, empty rows/columns, or an offset header).

papers.title: The health and wellbeing impact of arts engagement: A longitudinal outcome-wide approach in 22 countries
papers.summary:
-  We classified 32 files: 14 data, 1 code, 17 documentation.
-  We found 14 tabular data files and extracted 1703 columns from 8 of them.
-  We grouped the files into 2 study groups (ex1, ex2).
-  4 tabular data files could not be read because they were not downloaded. This can happen for private repositories or failed downloads; you can also pass `local_path` to point at a local copy.
-  2 files read as a table but are not a usable rectangular dataset (GFS_Year1_Translations.xlsx: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; GFS_Year2_Translations.xlsx: 100% of columns are free text, not variables). No columns were extracted and they were not sent to the LLM. Share the underlying data as a plain rectangular table (one header row, one column per variable) with a codebook: GFS_Year1_Translations.xlsx, GFS_Year2_Translations.xlsx. We ran automated data-quality checks on 1703 columns; 60 columns have at least one potential issue (57 columns with no observed values (entirely empty); 3 columns with inconsistent category casing). We detected demographic columns for Age, Gender. 2 of 2 spreadsheet files have at least one formatting issue (colour coding, merged cells, empty rows/columns, or an offset header).

papers.title: Seven replicated genomic associations of myalgic encephalomyelitis (ME/CFS): a biobank study
papers.summary:
-  We classified 293 files: 31 data, 95 code, 58 documentation, 46 materials, 63 unknown.
-  We found 31 tabular data files and extracted 1462 columns from 31 of them.
-  We grouped the files into 3 study groups (ex1, ex2, ex3), plus 3 collection-level files (README/ro-crate metadata). We ran automated data-quality checks on 1462 columns; 277 columns have at least one potential issue (262 columns with no observed values (entirely empty); 13 columns whose name contains file-illegal characters or is excessively long; 1 column with numeric values stored as text; 1 column with leading/trailing whitespace). We detected demographic column for Gender.

papers.title: Future-Information Leakage in 30-Day Readmission Prediction: An Empirical Audit and a Calibrated Electronic Health Record Model in Medicare-Insured Adults
papers.summary:
-  We classified 1088 files: 373 data, 468 code, 28 documentation, 211 materials, 2 output, 6 unknown.
-  We found 12 tabular data files and extracted 492 columns from 10 of them.
-  We grouped the files into 3 study groups (ex1, ex2, ex3), plus 4 collection-level files (README/ro-crate metadata).
-  2 files read as a table but are not a usable rectangular dataset (results/table1_cohort.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; thiagobandeira1/Medicare-30day-Readmission-MIMIC-IV-v16.1-jamia.zip/thiagobandeira1-Medicare-30day-Readmission-MIMIC-IV-f1f90fa/results/table1_cohort.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables). No columns were extracted and they were not sent to the LLM. Share the underlying data as a plain rectangular table (one header row, one column per variable) with a codebook: results/table1_cohort.csv, thiagobandeira1/Medicare-30day-Readmission-MIMIC-IV-v16.1-jamia.zip/thiagobandeira1-Medicare-30day-Readmission-MIMIC-IV-f1f90fa/results/table1_cohort.csv. We ran automated data-quality checks on 492 columns; 2 columns have at least one potential issue (2 columns with numeric values stored as text). We detected demographic column for Race.

papers.title: El Nino Southern Oscillation shapes cholera in Africa
papers.summary:
-  We could not list every file of 1 repository, so the checks did not see all its files: R/S (could not be listed: invalid or inaccessible GitHub repository).
-  We classified 678 files: 132 data, 521 code, 13 documentation, 3 materials, 1 output, 8 unknown.
-  We found 127 tabular data files and extracted 1440 columns from 106 of them.
-  We grouped the files into 3 study groups (ex1, ex2, ex3), plus 9 collection-level files (README/ro-crate metadata).
-  4 files read as a table but are not a usable rectangular dataset (function_renames.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; D11_enso_exposure_by_track.csv: 71% of columns are free text, not variables; D28_software_session.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; T1a_enso_rain_mechanisms.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables). No columns were extracted and they were not sent to the LLM. Share the underlying data as a plain rectangular table (one header row, one column per variable) with a codebook: function_renames.csv, D11_enso_exposure_by_track.csv, D28_software_session.csv, T1a_enso_rain_mechanisms.csv. We ran automated data-quality checks on 1440 columns; 7 columns have at least one potential issue (5 columns with no observed values (entirely empty); 2 columns with numeric values stored as text). 1 of 1 spreadsheet file has at least one formatting issue (colour coding, merged cells, empty rows/columns, or an offset header).

papers.title: Most coronial recommendations in Australia have no published response: a national analysis of findings and agency responses
papers.summary:
-  We classified 310 files: 122 data, 94 code, 28 documentation, 58 materials, 8 unknown.
-  We found 110 tabular data files and extracted 858 columns from 106 of them.
-  We grouped the files into 1 study group (ex1), plus 4 collection-level files (README/ro-crate metadata).
-  4 files read as a table but are not a usable rectangular dataset (outputs/vic_case_review_2026-10/CASE_REVIEW.xlsx: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; outputs_v2/tables/supplementary_stats_summary.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; Coronial-NLP-Analysis-v2.1.0.zip/Coronial-NLP-Analysis-v2.1.0/outputs/vic_case_review_2026-10/CASE_REVIEW.xlsx: 100% of columns are free text, not variables; Coronial-NLP-Analysis-v2.1.0.zip/Coronial-NLP-Analysis-v2.1.0/outputs_v2/tables/supplementary_stats_summary.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables). No columns were extracted and they were not sent to the LLM. Share the underlying data as a plain rectangular table (one header row, one column per variable) with a codebook: outputs/vic_case_review_2026-10/CASE_REVIEW.xlsx, outputs_v2/tables/supplementary_stats_summary.csv, Coronial-NLP-Analysis-v2.1.0.zip/Coronial-NLP-Analysis-v2.1.0/outputs/vic_case_review_2026-10/CASE_REVIEW.xlsx, Coronial-NLP-Analysis-v2.1.0.zip/Coronial-NLP-Analysis-v2.1.0/outputs_v2/tables/supplementary_stats_summary.csv. We ran automated data-quality checks on 858 columns; 58 columns have at least one potential issue (50 columns whose name contains file-illegal characters or is excessively long; 8 columns with no observed values (entirely empty)). 6 of 6 spreadsheet files have at least one formatting issue (colour coding, merged cells, empty rows/columns, or an offset header).

papers.title: Molecular characterisation of a Klebsiella pneumoniae neonatal sepsis outbreak in a rural Gambian hospital: a retrospective genomic epidemiology investigation
papers.summary:
-  We classified 74 files: 19 data, 13 code, 24 documentation, 3 materials, 15 unknown.
-  We found 12 tabular data files and extracted 1380 columns from 11 of them.
-  We grouped the files into 2 study groups (ex1, ex2), plus 5 collection-level files (README/ro-crate metadata).
-  1 file read as a table but is not a usable rectangular dataset (fig01_epi_curve.csv: 100% of columns are free text, not variables). No columns were extracted and they were not sent to the LLM. Share the underlying data as a plain rectangular table (one header row, one column per variable) with a codebook: fig01_epi_curve.csv. We ran automated data-quality checks on 1380 columns; 193 columns have at least one potential issue (174 columns with numeric values stored as text; 7 columns whose name contains file-illegal characters or is excessively long; 6 columns with inconsistent category casing; 4 columns with no observed values (entirely empty); 2 columns that look like geographic coordinates). We detected demographic columns for Age, Gender. 1 of 1 spreadsheet file has at least one formatting issue (colour coding, merged cells, empty rows/columns, or an offset header).

papers.summary:
-  We classified 520 files: 292 data, 50 code, 4 documentation, 172 materials, 2 unknown.
-  We found 292 tabular data files and extracted 1656 columns from 286 of them.
-  We grouped the files into 3 study groups (ex1, ex2, pilot1), plus 2 collection-level files (README/ro-crate metadata).
-  6 R workspace files (`.RData`/`.rda`) contain no reusable tabular data — only fitted models or saved session objects. Such files need R (and the exact packages used) to open and are not machine-readable. Share the underlying data as CSV (or a documented `.sav`/`.dta`) with a codebook so it can be reused without R: 02_data/02_pilot/pilot_article.Rdata, 02_data/article.Rdata, 02_data/article_2.Rdata, alexdgibson/cpm_auc-pre_print_release.zip/alexdgibson-cpm_auc-edfcfd2/02_data/02_pilot/pilot_article.Rdata, alexdgibson/cpm_auc-pre_print_release.zip/alexdgibson-cpm_auc-edfcfd2/02_data/article.Rdata, alexdgibson/cpm_auc-pre_print_release.zip/alexdgibson-cpm_auc-edfcfd2/02_data/article_2.Rdata. We ran automated data-quality checks on 1656 columns; 248 columns have at least one potential issue (134 columns with no observed values (entirely empty); 42 columns with numeric values stored as text; 30 columns with inconsistent category casing; 24 columns whose values look like personal information; 20 columns of free text that may contain personal detail; 10 columns whose name suggests personal information; 4 columns whose name contains file-illegal characters or is excessively long; 2 columns whose names become identical when special characters are removed; 2 columns with leading/trailing whitespace).

No columns were extracted and they were not sent to the LLM. Share the underlying data as a plain rectangular table (one header row, one column per variable) with a codebook: table_one_osa_clusters.xlsx, S9_auroc_uncertainty.xlsx. We ran automated data-quality checks on 160 columns; 21 columns have at least one potential issue (15 columns whose name contains file-illegal characters or is excessively long; 6 columns with numeric values stored as text). We detected demographic column for Age. 6 of 10 spreadsheet files have at least one formatting issue (colour coding, merged cells, empty rows/columns, or an offset header).
